name: Greenwave Technology Solutions, Inc.
summary: Operating through its subsidiary, Empire Services, Inc., Greenwave Technology Solutions, Inc. runs metal recycling centers across Virginia and North Carolina. These facilities specialize in the collection, classification, and preparation of raw ferrous and nonferrous scrap metals, facilitating the recovery of valuable resources such as iron, steel, aluminum, copper, lead, stainless steel, and zinc. The company's business also includes the acquisition and subsequent sale of both processed and unprocessed scrap materials to steel mills and a variety of other industrial purchasers. Originally established in 2002, Greenwave Technology Solutions, Inc. is based in Denver, Colorado, and was previously named MassRoots, Inc.
